subject: Initial eval play & stakeholder commitment plan
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sethi <priya.sethi@horizonhealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 09 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial eval play & stakeholder commitment plan

Hi Priya / Tom —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I pulled together an initial evaluation play and a lightweight MAP to help Horizon Health align stakeholders and lock a realistic close window. The doc has two parts: a 6-week evaluation checklist (features + success criteria) and a proposed exec signoff & procurement timeline.

Key asks from our side:
- Confirm the evaluation owners on your side (technical, privacy/security, procurement)
- Confirm a preferred week for a production pilot (we penciled Wk 3)

I attached the Redwood MAP template and an example evaluation matrix for reference. I also shared a live Google Doc so we can co-edit: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-redwood-map-v2

Proposed milestones (high level):
1) Week 0 — Kickoff / access provisioning
2) Weeks 1-3 — Feature evaluation + performance baseline
3) Week 4 — Security review & compliance checklist
4) Week 5 — Pilot results + executive recap
5) Week 6 — Procurement / PO / contract signature

If the timeline looks aggressive, tell me which milestone you'd like to stretch. Happy to move the pilot window later; we want the MAP to reflect Horizon's internal rhythms.

Attachments: [redwood_map_template_v2.gdoc] [horizon-eval-matrix.xlsx]

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com

--
Previous meeting notes and success criteria (short):
- Primary win metric: 40% latency cost improvement vs current baseline OR stable p95 < 300ms for 99% of production-like requests- Security: SOC2 + customer-managed KMS required

From: Priya Sethi <priya.sethi@horizonhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Initial eval play & stakeholder commitment plan

Thanks Sean — this looks very helpful. A few notes from our side after syncing with the labs and security teams: 

- Security will need an extra week for the compliance checklist; can we move the security review to Week 5 and shift pilot to Week 4?
- Procurement wants to see a one-page cost summary for the pilot (can you add expected token estimates and a capped pilot spend?)
- I’ll confirm stakeholder names by EOD Tuesday; likely: Anita Rao (Engineering lead), Rahul Desai (Head of Privacy), and Marcus Hu (Procurement).

We’re generally aligned on the milestones. If you can update the MAP with the shifted weeks and include a pilot cost cap, we’ll mark internal owners and lock a kickoff for the week of May 18.

Thanks —
Priya Sethi
Director, Clinical Data Platforms | Horizon Health

- Success criteria: added a pass/fail matrix for latency, throughput, and response fidelity.
- Access: step-by-step runbook for service account provisioning (Jonas, Marissa — flag any infra blockers).

Proposed kickoff: Tue May 19 at 10:00 AM PT. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and the short agenda (30m).
